stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game asks you to turn the phone to landscape when it needs it, and an unlocked screen will rotate the page out from under you.
stumbles.why: Contradictory-seeming: with rotation locked in portrait, turning the phone to landscape won't rotate the page, and it's unclear why you'd lock it yet be asked to turn it. Also unclear what 'when it needs it' means.

stumbles.quote: Turn the phone to landscape when the prompt asks you to, and hold it the way you want to drive.
stumbles.why: Unclear which landscape direction to use, and how the 'way you want to drive' relates to the neutral tilt; also the controls (left/right, top away/toward) are ambiguous in landscape, since 'top of the phone' differs from portrait.

stumbles.quote: Tilt left or right to steer.
stumbles.why: In landscape, it's unclear which axis this means (rolling the phone around which edge). It's not explained how this fits with steering-wheel style holding.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate.
stumbles.why: In landscape the 'top' of the phone is ambiguous (the long edge facing away vs. the side edge), so the instruction can't be applied reliably.

stumbles.quote: the game takes the phone's tilt at that moment as straight ahead
stumbles.why: Unclear whether 'straight ahead' calibrates only steering or also the accelerate/brake neutral point.

stumbles.quote: It needs a phone with a motion sensor.
stumbles.why: Doesn't say whether Android phones need any permission, or what happens on non-iOS; 'On iOS, allow motion access' implies others differ but is unstated.

point: Open the page on a phone with a motion sensor, lock portrait rotation, allow motion access, pick track/laps/difficulty, tap Start engine, turn to landscape on prompt, hold steady until the lights go out, then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
